mission: Grip Lab: why do some surfaces save us from slipping?
equipment: Trainer sole or rubber, smooth plastic/laminate, fabric/carpet, rough card/sandpaper, everyday friction picture cards.
evidence: Annotated friction detective card or photo/model paired with the pupil’s explanation.

mission: Surface Test Lab: can our evidence identify the grippiest surface?
equipment: Small trolley/block, ramp or fixed release method, three safe surfaces, metre rule/tape, results table, tray.
evidence: Prediction + results table + conclusion; photo only when paired with learner reasoning.

mission: Mechanism Hunt: find the hidden force advantage in everyday objects.
equipment: Ruler and pivot, scissors (adult-controlled as needed), bottle opener, spanner, bicycle/gear images, rope/pulley image or simple pulley.
evidence: Mechanism classification plus pivot/turning annotation and gain/trade-off explanation.
media_note: Slug unproven — the Oak lesson appears in the unit listing but the exact URL could not be fetched. Flagged in-page as data-link-unverified.

mission: Lift It Smarter: investigate where the pivot should go.
equipment: Rulers/wood strips, stable pivots, light loads, trays, ruler/tape and optional spring balance.
evidence: Two or three pivot setups + effort/distance evidence + pupil conclusion.

mission: Science Detective: repair a test that cannot answer its own question.
equipment: Variable cards, three-box planning frame, trolley/ramp as a brief demo, unit cards, example result slips.
evidence: Pupil-authored plan showing change / measure + unit / controls / repeats.

mission: Evidence Lab: can another scientist trust our results?
equipment: Trolley/block, ramp, three surfaces, metre rules/tapes, prepared repeat table, calculators optional.
evidence: Plan + raw repeat data + conclusion + evaluation kept together.

mission: Mission Control: navigate the eight-planet Solar System.
equipment: Eight planet cards/counters, large Sun card, arrows/labels, optional string orbit, desk/floor model space.
evidence: Ordered Solar System strip/model + classification + gravity/motion explanation.
media_note: Slug unproven — the Oak lesson appears in the unit listing but the exact URL could not be fetched. Flagged in-page as data-link-unverified.

mission: Build Mission Control: make a model that tells the truth about what it represents.
equipment: Planet cards/balls, Sun marker, labels, tape/string, large paper and force/motion arrows.
evidence: Model photo/drawing + annotated gravity/motion arrows + one model limitation.

mission: Moon Detective: why does the Moon seem to change shape?
equipment: Torch/lamp, foam ball, Earth/observer marker, four/eight phase cards, bright-room diagram alternative.
evidence: Phase sequence/model + reflected-light explanation + phase/eclipses distinction.

mission: Lunar Studio: use a model to make the phases appear on command.
equipment: Torches/lamps, foam balls, phase-wheel sheets/cards, pencils and split pins/clips if building wheels.
evidence: Phase wheel/model record + sunlight direction + learner explanation and model limitation.
